integrity: All numerical invariants are computed with exact integer arithmetic by two self-contained implementations using different enumeration and Fourier-evaluation methods; tables and checkers are embedded in this package.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact result for complete-graph forest incidence at 3<=n<=6; no general classification for n>=7.
Searches did not exhaust unindexed historical sign-evaluation tables or differently formulated forest-spectrum studies.
Computational completeness is based on auditable exhaustive finite loops, not independent mathematical certification.
title: First nontrivial Walsh singularity of complete-graph forests: exact six-vertex cancellation orbits and sharp range projection
